# @alexify/syncom

> Fast, zero-dependency distributed data sync engine for JavaScript. Local-first
> storage with a hash-linked integrity log, CRDT deltas, and JavaScript smart
> contracts — one API across Node.js and the browser.

## Key facts

- Package: `@alexify/syncom` (npm), MIT, source at https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/syncom
- Requires Node.js >= 22, or a browser with OPFS and Web Crypto (secure context)
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** Browser bundle is ~4.7 KB min+gzip
- CommonJS, no build step; `src/` ships as published
- Entry points: `.` (Node `index.js` / browser `browser.js` via the `browser` export condition)
- Exports: `open`, `Storage`, `Blockchain`, `SmartContract`, `DataReader`, `SyncManager`,
  `diff`, `merge`, `apply`, `calculateHash`, `generateKeys`, `encrypt`, `decrypt`,
  `loadKeys`, `read`, `write`, `exists`, `remove`
- `Storage`, `Blockchain` and `SyncManager` initialise asynchronously: `await new Blockchain(path)`
- In the browser `calculateHash`, `encrypt` and `decrypt` return promises; in Node.js they are synchronous
- `merge` ADDS numbers rather than replacing them — this is the counter CRDT and is deliberate
- **Not implemented:** `storage.sync` registers and persists peer nodes, but no
  transport exists; `sync.start()` is a no-op

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/getting-started): install, open a storage, records, validation.
- [Storage](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/storage): explicit API, compare-and-swap, records, references, schema collections, on-disk layout.
- [CRDT deltas](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/crdt): diff/merge/apply semantics, grow-only sets, the numeric-addition rule.
- [Blockchain log](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/chain): block structure, hash linking, validate cost, per-record verification.
- [Smart contracts](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/contracts): storing procedures in the chain, DataReader, the `new Function` risk, serialisation limits.
- [Sync](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/sync): the node registry and what a transport would still need.
- [Browser](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/guide/browser): OPFS and Web Crypto, the async signature differences, bundle size.
- [API reference](https://syncomjs.vercel.app/reference/api): every export with signatures and return types.
